value.description: Systematic presentation and communication of basic and specialized knowledge as well as methodological skills through lecture, possibly in connection with demonstrations or experiments.
Working through and deepening of teaching materials and training in subject methodology and providing specific skills through processing and discussion of exemplary tasks.

Development of scientific knowledge or addressing current problems using scientific methods, typically through student-prepared contributions, learning and practicing or deepening presentation and discussion techniques.

Guided execution of practical tasks in the experimental and apparatus area and/or computer simulations; training in the application of scientific investigation and solution methods; imparting of technical skills and insights into functional processes.

Development of concepts as well as realization of solutions for complex, practical tasks; imparting social competence through largely independent processing of tasks while receiving technical and methodological guidance.

Experience of professional work through active participation, usually outside the university (practice site) under on-site guidance and typically with academic and methodological support from a lecturer.

A course preparing for the conduct of tutorials, including training in the communication of subject-specific and didactic competencies as well as learning of presentation and discussion techniques, overseen by academic staff.
The specific order for the study program specifies what requirements are placed on self-study.
